d: Striking cross-shaped asterism flying along the Milky Way galactic plane, anchoring the Summer Triangle.

hip-102098.x: Colossal blue-white supergiant star marking the tail of the swan and topmost vertex of the Summer Triangle.

hip-100453.x: Luminous supergiant located at the intersection of the Northern Cross, surrounded by diffuse emission nebulae.
hip-100453.t: Gamma Cygni · Heart of the Swan

hip-102488.x: Orange giant star marking the eastern wing of the celestial Swan.

gaia-2079784488001577600.x: Triple star system marking the western wing tip of the Swan.

gaia-1872046609345556480.x: Primary K-dwarf of the famous 61 Cygni binary (11.4 ly), the first star to have its distance measured via stellar parallax.

gaia-1872046574983497216.x: Secondary K-type dwarf companion in the 61 Cygni binary system.
